// PreToolUse marker hook. Writes a marker line, then exits with the code named
// in TIPHYS_PROBE_EXIT (default 0). The marker file is the beacon: its presence
// is the ONLY evidence that the hook fired.
import { appendFileSync } from 'node:fs'
const marker = process.env.TIPHYS_PROBE_MARKER
const wantExit = Number(process.env.TIPHYS_PROBE_EXIT ?? '0')
let raw = ''
process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8')
process.stdin.on('data', (c) => { raw += c })
process.stdin.on('end', () => {
  let parsed = null
  try { parsed = JSON.parse(raw) } catch { parsed = { PARSE_FAILED: raw.slice(0, 400) } }
  const line = JSON.stringify({
    fired_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    arm: process.env.TIPHYS_PROBE_ARM ?? 'unset',
    hook_event_name: parsed?.hook_event_name ?? null,
    permission_mode: parsed?.permission_mode ?? null,
    tool_name: parsed?.tool_name ?? null,
    cwd: parsed?.cwd ?? null,
    tool_input: parsed?.tool_input ?? null,
    exiting_with: wantExit
  })
  if (marker) appendFileSync(marker, line + '\n')
  if (wantExit === 2) {
    process.stderr.write('TIPHYS-PROBE-BLOCK: the PreToolUse hook refused this tool call\n')
  }
  process.exit(wantExit)
})
